title: The Backpack
lines: Tom packs his backpack for camp.
In it he has a hotdog and a napkin.
Dan tosses in catnip for his cat.
Tom and Dan hike up to the hilltop.
At sunset Tom cannot get his hotdog.
Dan grins. The cat is sitting on it.
Tom is upset. The hotdog is a mess.
Dan gives him a muffin and Tom grins.

questions.listenFor: A hotdog, a napkin, and catnip. Stated in the story - have them find the lines instead of listing it for them.
The cat sat on his hotdog and squashed it. If they only say "the cat," ask "and what did the cat do?"

questions.ask: Do you think Dan should have put the catnip in Tom's backpack? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to the story - the catnip is what pulled the cat in.
